### Add Line Numbers

URL: https://flxify.dev/tools/add-line-numbers/
Category: Text Manipulation
Description: Prepends line numbers to each line with aligned spacing Free online add line numbers tool. 100% client-side, your data never leaves your browser.
Keywords: line, number, prefix, count, add
  Q: Is the Add Line Numbers tool free?
  A: Yes, Add Line Numbers on Flxify is completely free to use with no limits or sign-up required.
  Q: Is my data safe when using Add Line Numbers?
  A: All processing happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device and is never sent to any server.
  Q: Can I use Add Line Numbers offline?
  A: After the initial page load, the tool works offline. All processing is done client-side with no server dependency.
